notes_for_editor: No build date, agency or staffing found in any source read, so none is entered. The only physical description is the 1960 National Geodetic Survey station record, reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page; the 100-ft height is from that record and is entered as 30.5 m. The station record puts the tower at the Southern Illinois Forestry headquarters, but no source names the agency that ran it. The record's coordinates (38.03375, -88.92197) were not checked against the survey location. The March 2016 photo credited to Bob Frakes on the source page is not described in any text read, so it is not cited. The record is headed National Geodetic Survey but says it was described by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1960; the story uses that wording. The Frakes article does not mention Benton at all, so the story says only that the article does not mention the Benton tower as standing.
